description:
Lee Dojin finds himself imprisoned in a mysterious facility. When he opens his eyes, Kim Minwoo is standing before him. Looking back, Dojin has always lived selfishly, using others for his own benefit. And ever since he met Minwoo, a series of unexplained incidents have begun to unfold between them… What exactly happened to these two?
